summaryEn: July 3rd's 27 papers are headlined by agent intelligence and evaluation: new frameworks for autonomous policy evolution (EvoPolicyGym), bounded-memory long-horizon agents (AgenticSTS), and data-agent assessment (AgenticDataBench) sit alongside principled memory management (AutoMem, DuoMem) and skill-grounded process supervision (SkillCoach). A strong secondary thread covers inference efficiency and architecture — multiprobe grid ANN scaling, multi-resolution diffusion acceleration (MrFlow), and quantum-inspired network forecasting — while medical multimodal reasoning (MRPO) and controllable visual generation (InstanceControl) round out a rich, agent-centric day.
summaryZh: 7月3日的27篇论文以智能体智能与评估为主轴：自主策略演化框架（EvoPolicyGym）、有界记忆长时程智能体（AgenticSTS）和数据智能体评测（AgenticDataBench）相继亮相，同时配套原则性记忆管理（AutoMem、DuoMem）与技能基础过程监督（SkillCoach）的架构创新。推理效率与架构探索构成强劲副线——多探针网格ANN扩展规律、多分辨率扩散加速（MrFlow）和量子启发网络预测——医疗多模态推理（MRPO）与可控视觉生成（InstanceControl）为这一充实的智能体主题日画上圆满句点。

papers.titleEn: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
papers.titleZh: 权重即程序：模糊函数的编程范式
papers.problemEn: Tasks like log filtering, JSON repair, and intent ranking resist clean rule-based code yet are expensive to outsource to large LLM APIs at the cost of locality and reproducibility.
papers.problemZh: 日志过滤、JSON修复和意图排序等任务难以用规则实现，外包给大型LLM API又代价高昂，且缺乏本地化和可复现性。
papers.innovationEn: PAW compiles a natural-language function spec into a tiny parameter-efficient adapter via a 4B compiler trained on FuzzyBench (10M examples), then runs it on a frozen 0.6B interpreter — a one-time compile yielding cheap, offline, reusable artifacts.
papers.innovationZh: PAW通过在FuzzyBench（1000万样本）上训练的4B编译器，将自然语言函数规格编译为微小的参数高效适配器，再由冻结的0.6B解释器执行——一次编译，得到可复用的离线轻量制品。
papers.resultEn: A 0.6B Qwen3 interpreter with PAW adapters matches Qwen3-32B direct prompting at 1/50th the memory, running at 30 tokens/s on a MacBook M3.
papers.resultZh: 搭载PAW适配器的0.6B Qwen3解释器性能与Qwen3-32B直接提示持平，内存仅为其1/50，在MacBook M3上以30 tokens/s运行。

papers.titleEn: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.titleZh: AgenticSTS：长时程LLM智能体的有界内存测试平台
papers.problemEn: Accumulating-context agents mix memories into an unanalyzable prompt jumble, making it hard to isolate which memory layer contributes to long-horizon decisions.
papers.problemZh: 累积上下文智能体将记忆混杂成难以分析的提示堆叠，难以隔离哪个记忆层对长时程决策起作用。
papers.innovationEn: A bounded contract assembles each decision from a fresh prompt via typed retrieval, enabling clean per-layer ablation; instantiated in Slay the Spire 2 requiring hundreds of tactical and strategic decisions.
papers.innovationZh: 有界契约通过类型化检索为每次决策组装全新提示，实现干净的逐层消融实验；在需要数百次战术与战略决策的《斩杀尖塔2》中实例化。
papers.resultEn: Adding a triggered strategic skill layer improves win rate from 3/10 to 6/10 (directional, Fisher p≈0.37); public baselines report zero wins at the same difficulty.
papers.resultZh: 添加触发式战略技能层将胜率从3/10提升至6/10（方向性结果，Fisher p≈0.37）；公开基准在相同难度下胜率为零。

papers.titleEn: EvoPolicyGym: Evaluating Autonomous Policy Evolution in Interactive Environments
papers.titleZh: EvoPolicyGym：在交互式环境中评估自主策略演化
papers.problemEn: Existing agent evaluations collapse iterative policy-improvement into a final score, obscuring how agents allocate budgets and convert feedback into parametric updates.
papers.problemZh: 现有智能体评估将迭代式策略改进压缩为最终得分，掩盖了智能体如何分配预算并将反馈转化为参数更新的过程。
papers.innovationEn: EvoPolicyGym defines Autonomous Policy Evolution as a controlled setting where an agent repeatedly edits an executable policy under a fixed interaction budget, using compact RL environments with trajectory-level diagnostics.
papers.innovationZh: EvoPolicyGym将自主策略演化定义为受控评估场景：智能体在固定交互预算下反复编辑可执行策略，配合紧凑RL环境与轨迹级诊断工具。
papers.resultEn: GPT-5.5 achieves the strongest aggregate rank score and top-two performance on all 16 environments in the EvoPolicyGym suite.
papers.resultZh: GPT-5.5在EvoPolicyGym全部16个环境中取得最高综合排名分和前二位置。

papers.titleEn: Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
papers.titleZh: 渐变为混合注意力模型
papers.problemEn: Converting Transformers to hybrid full/linear-attention models requires choosing which layers keep full attention, but existing heuristics ignore inter-layer dependencies under a global hybrid configuration.
papers.problemZh: 将Transformer转换为混合全/线性注意力模型需要选择哪些层保留全注意力，但现有启发式方法忽略了全局混合配置下的层间依赖。
papers.innovationEn: FlashMorph formulates layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem, equipping each full-attention layer with a linear-attention branch and jointly optimizing gating on synthetic long-context retrieval data with a linearization regularization.
papers.innovationZh: FlashMorph将层选择建模为预算约束优化问题，为每个全注意力层配置线性注意力分支，并在合成长上下文检索数据上联合优化门控，附带线性化正则化。
papers.resultEn: FlashMorph discovers more effective hybrid configurations, preserving long-context recall and general benchmarks while substantially reducing layer selection cost versus prior methods.
papers.resultZh: FlashMorph发现更有效的混合配置，在保持长上下文召回和通用基准性能的同时，相比现有方法大幅降低层选择成本。

papers.titleEn: Multi-Resolution Flow Matching: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Staged Sampling
papers.titleZh: 多分辨率流匹配：通过分阶段采样实现无需训练的扩散加速
papers.problemEn: Multi-resolution diffusion strategies achieve 5× speedup but suffer from blurring or artifacts caused by upsampling in latent space with partial-region modification.
papers.problemZh: 多分辨率扩散策略可实现5×加速，但在潜在空间中进行上采样并局部区域修改，会产生模糊或伪影问题。
papers.innovationEn: MrFlow uses a staged low-to-high-resolution pipeline: low-res generation → pixel-space GAN super-resolution → noise injection for high-frequency resampling → high-res detail refinement, all without training or runtime identification.
papers.innovationZh: MrFlow采用分阶段低分辨率到高分辨率流水线：低分辨率生成→像素空间GAN超分辨率→噪声注入以实现高频重采样→高分辨率细节精修，全程无需训练或运行时识别。
papers.resultEn: MrFlow achieves 10× end-to-end acceleration on FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image within a 1% OneIG gap, and up to 25× when combined with timestep distillation.
papers.resultZh: MrFlow在FLUX.1-dev和Qwen-Image上实现10×端到端加速，OneIG差距在1%以内，结合时间步蒸馏可达25×加速。

papers.titleEn: AgenticDataBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Data Agents
papers.titleZh: AgenticDataBench：数据智能体综合评测基准
papers.problemEn: LLM-based data agents lack comprehensive benchmarks that evaluate them across diverse domains with fine-grained skill-level granularity.
papers.problemZh: 基于LLM的数据智能体缺乏能够跨多领域、以细粒度技能维度进行评估的综合基准。
papers.innovationEn: AgenticDataBench covers 15 vertical domains (including 5 real-world fintech B2B cases), quantifies coverage by data-science skills extracted via skill-aligned hierarchical clustering from Stack Overflow solutions, and includes a systematic LLM-based task generation pipeline.
papers.innovationZh: AgenticDataBench涵盖15个垂直领域（含5个真实金融科技B2B案例），通过从Stack Overflow解决方案中提取技能并进行技能对齐层次聚类来量化覆盖度，并包含系统化的LLM任务生成流水线。
papers.resultEn: State-of-the-art data agents are evaluated with detailed skill-level insights, revealing gaps in practical data science automation across domains.
papers.resultZh: 通过细粒度技能层面的评估揭示了当前最优数据智能体在跨领域实际数据科学自动化中的能力缺口。

papers.titleEn: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
papers.titleZh: WorldDirector：构建具有持久动态记忆的可控世界模拟器
papers.problemEn: Existing video world models entangle physical dynamics with pixel rendering and require continuous visual observation to sustain object motion, losing identity when objects leave the frame.
papers.problemZh: 现有视频世界模型将物理动态与像素渲染耦合，且依赖连续视觉观察来维持物体运动，物体离开画面后身份信息丢失。
papers.innovationEn: WorldDirector decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation: an LLM coordinates 3D trajectories and camera movements, which then serve as control signals for video generation, preserving identity even after prolonged off-screen periods.
papers.innovationZh: WorldDirector将语义运动编排与视觉生成解耦：LLM协调3D轨迹与摄像机运动，将其作为视频生成的控制信号，即使物体长时间离开画面也能保持身份信息。
papers.resultEn: WorldDirector supports synthesis of complex, extended events with unprecedented controllability and persistent dynamic object memory across arbitrary viewpoints.
papers.resultZh: WorldDirector支持合成复杂、长时程事件，具备前所未有的可控性，并在任意视角下保持持久的动态物体记忆。

papers.titleEn: Breaking Failure Cascades: Step-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Medical Multimodal Reasoning
papers.titleZh: 打破错误级联：医疗多模态推理的步感知强化学习
papers.problemEn: Outcome-centric RL for clinical image reasoning suffers sparse credit assignment; early-stage reasoning failures cascade into wrong answers in 64% of error cases.
papers.problemZh: 以结果为中心的临床图像推理RL奖励稀疏，早期推理失败在64%的错误案例中级联导致最终答案错误。
papers.innovationEn: MRPO assigns exponentially larger penalties to tokens in early invalid reasoning steps when the final answer is incorrect, targeting the cascade source without disrupting successful reasoning paths.
papers.innovationZh: MRPO在最终答案错误时对早期无效推理步骤中的token赋予指数级更大的惩罚，精准打击级联源头而不干扰成功推理路径。
papers.resultEn: MRPO on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct surpasses HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B by 2.79 points and reduces early-stage reasoning failures from 64.0% to 13.0%.
papers.resultZh: MRPO在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上超越HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 2.79个点，并将早期推理失败率从64.0%降至13.0%。

papers.titleEn: SkillCoach: Self-Evolving Rubrics for Evaluating and Enhancing Agentic Skill-Use
papers.titleZh: SkillCoach：用于评估和增强智能体技能使用的自进化评分标准
papers.problemEn: Final verifier accuracy is too coarse to evaluate agent skill-use quality; agents can pass through trial-and-error with distractor skills, skipped steps, or wrong compositions.
papers.problemZh: 最终验证器准确率粒度太粗，难以评估智能体技能使用质量；智能体可能通过选择干扰技能、跳过步骤或错误组合来蒙混过关。
papers.innovationEn: SkillCoach derives skill-grounded process rubrics from real rollouts covering four dimensions — skill selection, following, composition, and grounded reflection — keeping the external verifier as a separate outcome signal.
papers.innovationZh: SkillCoach从真实推演中提炼技能基准过程评分标准，覆盖四个维度：技能选择、技能遵循、技能组合与技能基础反思，并将外部验证器作为独立结果信号保留。
papers.resultEn: Evolved rubrics expose failures hidden by final accuracy and provide stronger supervision signals than outcome-only filtering for training improved agents.
papers.resultZh: 进化后的评分标准能暴露最终准确率掩盖的失败，并比仅基于结果过滤提供更强的训练监督信号。

papers.titleEn: Logit-Contribution Scoring Identifies Non-Literal Retrieval Heads
papers.titleZh: 逻辑贡献评分识别非字面检索注意力头
papers.problemEn: Existing attention-head detectors only reward literal copy-paste retrieval, missing heads that synthesize meaning non-literally via their output-value circuit.
papers.problemZh: 现有注意力头检测器只奖励字面复制检索，遗漏了通过输出值电路进行非字面意义综合的注意力头。
papers.innovationEn: LOCOS scores each head by projecting its OV-circuit output onto the answer-token unembedding direction, contrasting needle vs. off-needle positions in a single forward pass.
papers.innovationZh: LOCOS通过将每个头的OV电路输出投影到答案token的反嵌入方向上进行评分，在单次前向传播中对比目标位置与非目标位置。
papers.resultEn: Ablating 50 LOCOS-selected heads on Qwen3-8B collapses ROUGE-L from 0.401 to 0.000 on NoLiMa, while the strongest baseline still retains 0.292.
papers.resultZh: 对Qwen3-8B消融50个LOCOS选出的注意力头，NoLiMa上的ROUGE-L从0.401崩溃至0.000，而最强基线仍保留0.292。

papers.titleEn: Optimizing Visual Generative Models via Distribution-wise Rewards
papers.titleZh: 基于分布感知奖励优化视觉生成模型
papers.problemEn: Sample-wise RL rewards for visual generation cause reward hacking: all samples optimize toward the same direction independently, collapsing image diversity.
papers.problemZh: 视觉生成中的样本级RL奖励导致奖励作弊：所有样本独立地朝同一方向优化，导致图像多样性崩溃。
papers.innovationEn: Distribution-wise rewards account for the collective data distribution of generated samples, using a subset-replace strategy to efficiently estimate rewards, plus RL-optimized model-merging coefficients to reduce SDE-induced train-inference inconsistency.
papers.innovationZh: 分布感知奖励考虑生成样本的整体数据分布，采用子集替换策略高效估算奖励，并通过RL优化模型合并系数以减少SDE引入的训练-推理不一致性。
papers.resultEn: FID-50K improves from 8.30 to 5.77 for SiT and from 3.74 to 3.52 for EDM2, with enhanced perceptual quality while preserving sample diversity.
papers.resultZh: SiT的FID-50K从8.30改善至5.77，EDM2从3.74改善至3.52，在保持样本多样性的同时提升了感知质量。

papers.titleEn: AGVBench: A Reliability-Oriented Benchmark of Data Augmentation for Vein Recognition
papers.titleZh: AGVBench：面向可靠性的静脉识别数据增强基准
papers.problemEn: Augmentation strategies designed for natural images often disrupt fine-grained vein topology essential for biometric identity, and accuracy-centric evaluation misses adversarial vulnerabilities.
papers.problemZh: 为自然图像设计的增强策略常破坏生物识别身份所需的精细静脉拓扑，且以准确率为中心的评估遗漏对抗安全漏洞。
papers.innovationEn: AGVBench evaluates 30 augmentation strategies on 5 public vein datasets with 7 backbone architectures, assessing accuracy, calibration quality, and adversarial robustness in one standardized protocol.
papers.innovationZh: AGVBench在5个公开静脉数据集上用7种骨干架构评估30种增强策略，在统一标准协议下同时评估准确率、校准质量与对抗鲁棒性。
papers.resultEn: Multi-image mixing achieves the strongest recognition performance but is poorly calibrated and adversarially vulnerable, revealing a critical accuracy-security gap in biometric augmentation.
papers.resultZh: 多图混合方法准确率最高，但校准性差且易受对抗攻击，揭示了生物特征增强中关键的准确率-安全性矛盾。

papers.titleEn: AutoMem: Automated Learning of Memory as a Cognitive Skill
papers.titleZh: AutoMem：将记忆管理作为认知技能的自动化学习
papers.problemEn: LLMs lack principled memory management — developers manually design memory systems, preventing models from learning optimal strategies for encoding, retrieval, and knowledge organization.
papers.problemZh: LLM缺乏有原则的记忆管理机制——开发者手动设计记忆系统，阻碍了模型自主学习最优编码、检索与知识组织策略。
papers.innovationEn: AutoMem elevates file-system operations to first-class memory actions alongside task actions, training models to learn metamemory — when to encode, when to retrieve, and how to organize — along two axes: structural design (prompts, schemas) and operational quality.
papers.innovationZh: AutoMem将文件系统操作提升为与任务动作并列的一等内存动作，训练模型学习元记忆——何时编码、何时检索、如何组织——沿结构设计（提示词、模式）和操作质量两个轴优化。
papers.resultEn: Memory skill improves alongside task performance; the model learns to self-manage its memory system as a cognitive skill rather than relying on hand-crafted memory rules.
papers.resultZh: 记忆技能随任务性能同步提升，模型将记忆系统自我管理作为认知技能习得，而非依赖手工设计的记忆规则。

papers.titleEn: From SRA to Self-Flow: Data Augmentation or Self-Supervision?
papers.titleZh: 从SRA到Self-Flow：数据增强还是自监督？
papers.problemEn: Self-Flow's improvement over SRA in diffusion transformer training is attributed to token interactions between different noise levels, but this mechanism has never been rigorously tested.
papers.problemZh: Self-Flow相对SRA在扩散Transformer训练中的提升被归因于不同噪声级别间的token交互，但这一机制从未经过严格验证。
papers.innovationEn: Attention Separation preserves the dual-timestep input of Self-Flow but blocks cross-noise-level attention; removing token interaction doesn't degrade performance, revealing data augmentation — not interaction — drives the gain.
papers.innovationZh: 注意力分离保留Self-Flow的双时间步输入，但阻断跨噪声级别的注意力；去除token交互后性能不降反升，揭示是数据增强而非交互驱动了提升。
papers.resultEn: Attention Separation matches or improves Self-Flow while providing extra augmentation by splitting images into multiple effective training parts.
papers.resultZh: 注意力分离在不低于Self-Flow性能的同时，通过将图像拆分为多个有效训练部分进一步提供数据增强效果。

papers.titleEn: InstanceControl: Controllable Complex Image Generation without Instance Labeling
papers.titleZh: InstanceControl：无需实例标注的复杂图像可控生成
papers.problemEn: Controllable image generation in complex multi-instance scenes suffers attribute confusion, and existing fixes require labor-intensive manual instance labeling.
papers.problemZh: 复杂多实例场景中的可控图像生成存在属性混淆问题，而现有解决方案需要耗费大量人工进行实例标注。
papers.innovationEn: InstanceControl uses a VLM to automatically parse instance descriptions from text prompts and predict instance masks from visual conditions, with an adaptive mask refinement strategy that dynamically corrects noisy masks during generation.
papers.innovationZh: InstanceControl利用VLM自动从文本提示中解析实例描述并从视觉条件中预测实例掩码，并通过自适应掩码精修策略在生成过程中动态修正噪声掩码。
papers.resultEn: InstanceControl outperforms state-of-the-art methods with superior fidelity and precise instance-level control, eliminating any need for manual instance labeling.
papers.resultZh: InstanceControl在保真度和精确实例级控制方面优于最新方法，且无需任何人工实例标注。

papers.titleEn: When Search Agents Should Ask: DiscoBench for Clarification-Aware Deep Search
papers.titleZh: 搜索智能体何时应主动提问：面向澄清感知深度搜索的DiscoBench
papers.problemEn: Existing search benchmarks assume complete, explicit queries, but real-world requests are often vague or incorrect, causing search agents to propagate ambiguity along multi-step reasoning chains.
papers.problemZh: 现有搜索基准假设查询完整且明确，但现实请求常模糊或有误，导致搜索智能体在多步推理链中传播歧义。
papers.innovationEn: DiscoBench provides 211 samples across 11 domains covering 4 ambiguity types, with a multi-turn user simulator evaluating agents on task utility, ambiguity detection, interaction strategy, and cost efficiency.
papers.innovationZh: DiscoBench提供涵盖11个领域、4种歧义类型的211个样本，配备多轮交互用户模拟器，从任务效用、歧义检测、交互策略和成本效率四个维度评估智能体。
papers.resultEn: Experiments show ambiguity detection and clarification are distinct capabilities; repeatedly searching instead of asking for clarification often underperforms even direct guessing.
papers.resultZh: 实验表明歧义检测与澄清提问是不同能力；反复搜索而不主动提问往往不如直接猜测，揭示了当前搜索智能体的关键能力缺口。

papers.titleEn: AnyGroundBench: A Specialized-Domain Benchmark for Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models
papers.titleZh: AnyGroundBench：面向视觉语言模型视频时空定位的专业领域基准
papers.problemEn: VLM video grounding is only evaluated on general daily-life benchmarks, missing specialized domains with rare visual concepts and complex spatio-temporal dynamics that mirror real-world applications.
papers.problemZh: VLM视频时空定位仅在通用日常场景基准上评估，遗漏了具有罕见视觉概念和复杂时空动态的专业领域——而这些恰恰是真实应用场景。
papers.innovationEn: AnyGroundBench evaluates VLMs on specialized-domain video grounding with rare visual concepts and complex spatio-temporal dynamics, testing generalization beyond standard pre-training distributions.
papers.innovationZh: AnyGroundBench在包含罕见视觉概念和复杂时空动态的专业领域视频时空定位任务上评估VLM，测试超出标准预训练分布的泛化能力。
papers.resultEn: Reveals a critical disconnect between general benchmark performance and specialized-domain video grounding, highlighting VLMs' limited out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.resultZh: 揭示通用基准性能与专业领域视频定位之间的关键落差，凸显了VLM在分布外场景下泛化能力的不足。

papers.titleEn: PACE: A Proxy for Agentic Capability Evaluation
papers.titleZh: PACE：智能体能力评估的代理指标
papers.problemEn: Evaluating LLM agents on benchmarks like SWE-Bench and GAIA costs thousands of dollars, takes days, and requires complex infrastructure.
papers.problemZh: 在SWE-Bench和GAIA等基准上评估LLM智能体需花费数千美元、耗时数天，且需要复杂基础设施。
papers.innovationEn: PACE identifies a small, carefully selected subset of non-agentic capability benchmarks (testing reasoning, code generation, etc.) that accurately predict performance on expensive agentic benchmarks, enabling cheap indirect evaluation.
papers.innovationZh: PACE筛选出一小组精心挑选的非智能体能力基准（测试推理、代码生成等），能准确预测昂贵智能体基准上的性能，实现低成本间接评估。
papers.resultEn: Cheap non-agentic benchmarks accurately predict performance on expensive agentic evaluations, reducing evaluation costs by orders of magnitude.
papers.resultZh: 低成本的非智能体基准能准确预测昂贵智能体评估的性能，将评估成本降低数个数量级。

papers.titleEn: WARP: Weight-Space Analysis for Recovering Training Data Portfolios
papers.titleZh: WARP：从权重空间分析恢复训练数据配方
papers.problemEn: Foundation models rarely disclose their training data recipes (domain mixture weights), creating an access asymmetry where researchers study models without visibility into their training distributions.
papers.problemZh: 基础模型极少公开训练数据配方（领域混合权重），导致研究者只能研究模型却无法了解其训练分布。
papers.innovationEn: WARP uses weight-space analysis to reverse-engineer training data portfolios from model weights at the global distribution level, characterizing domain mixture weights rather than individual sample membership.
papers.innovationZh: WARP通过权重空间分析在全局分布层面从模型权重逆向还原训练数据配方，揭示领域混合权重而非个别样本的成员关系。
papers.resultEn: Successfully recovers training data portfolio estimates from weights, providing transparency into model training distributions without direct data access.
papers.resultZh: 成功从权重恢复训练数据配方估计，无需直接访问训练数据即可为模型训练分布提供透明度。

papers.titleEn: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic Pretraining for VLAs
papers.titleZh: 先学动，再学做：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的任务无关预训练
papers.problemEn: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are bottlenecked by scarce expert demonstrations that conflate physical competence (how to move) with semantic alignment (what to do).
papers.problemZh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型受限于稀缺专家演示，而这些演示将物理运动能力（怎么动）与语义对齐（做什么）混为一谈。
papers.innovationEn: Decomposition Hypothesis: only semantic alignment needs language supervision. Task-agnostic motor pretraining trains physical competence on unlabeled motion data first, then fine-tunes semantic alignment with few expert demonstrations.
papers.innovationZh: 分解假说：只有语义对齐需要语言监督。任务无关运动预训练先在无标注运动数据上训练物理运动能力，再以少量专家演示微调语义对齐。
papers.resultEn: Decoupling physical competence from semantic alignment reduces VLA dependence on expensive expert demonstrations while improving sample efficiency.
papers.resultZh: 将物理运动能力与语义对齐解耦，减少VLA对昂贵专家演示的依赖，同时提升样本效率。

papers.titleEn: Denser ≠ Better: Limits of On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Post-Training
papers.titleZh: 密不等于好：持续后训练中在策略自蒸馏的局限
papers.problemEn: On-policy self-distillation is promoted as a solution to catastrophic forgetting in continual post-training, but its failure modes under conflicting distributions are under-examined.
papers.problemZh: 在策略自蒸馏被推广为持续后训练中灾难性遗忘的解决方案，但其在冲突分布下的失败模式尚未得到充分研究。
papers.innovationEn: SDPO (Self-Distillation Policy Optimization) systematically reveals that denser supervision signals help when teacher signals are stable and aligned, but fail under conflicting distributions or domain shifts.
papers.innovationZh: SDPO（自蒸馏策略优化）系统性地揭示：在教师信号稳定对齐时，更密集的监督信号有助于专业化，但在冲突分布或领域偏移下则会失败。
papers.resultEn: SDPO can accelerate in-domain specialization with stable teacher signals but struggles with catastrophic forgetting under conflicting distributions or domain shifts.
papers.resultZh: SDPO能在稳定教师信号下加速领域专业化，但在冲突分布或领域偏移下仍难逃灾难性遗忘。

papers.titleEn: DuoMem: Towards Capable On-Device Memory Agents via Dual-Space Distillation
papers.titleZh: DuoMem：通过双空间蒸馏构建高能力端侧记忆智能体
papers.problemEn: Memory-augmented LLM agents require large models and long contexts for complex procedural tasks, making them impractical for resource-constrained on-device deployment.
papers.problemZh: 记忆增强型LLM智能体处理复杂程序性任务需要大模型和长上下文，在资源受限的端侧设备上部署不现实。
papers.innovationEn: DuoMem uses dual-space distillation — transferring both the reasoning process and memory management skills from a large teacher to compact student models — enabling capable on-device memory agents.
papers.innovationZh: DuoMem采用双空间蒸馏，同时将推理过程和记忆管理技能从大型教师模型迁移到紧凑学生模型，实现高能力端侧记忆智能体。
papers.resultEn: Compact student models acquire capable procedural problem-solving and memory management skills via dual-space distillation, enabling deployment on resource-constrained devices.
papers.resultZh: 紧凑学生模型通过双空间蒸馏获得程序性问题求解和记忆管理能力，可在资源受限设备上部署。

papers.titleEn: Representation Distribution Matching for One-Step Visual Generation
papers.titleZh: 一步视觉生成的表征分布匹配
papers.problemEn: The design space of one-step image generators trained by matching generated and reference feature distributions is poorly understood, limiting principled model design.
papers.problemZh: 通过匹配生成特征与参考特征分布训练的一步图像生成器设计空间尚不明确，限制了有原则的模型设计。
papers.innovationEn: RDM elucidates the design space along two axes (how distributions are compared, what representations are used), finding that classical MMD with modern frozen encoders becomes a strong training signal for one-step generators.
papers.innovationZh: RDM沿两个轴（如何比较分布、使用何种表征）阐明设计空间，发现经典MMD配合现代冻结编码器成为一步生成器的强训练信号。
papers.resultEn: Classical MMD, previously too weak for image generation, becomes competitive with modern encoders; three key design findings guide one-step generator development.
papers.resultZh: 此前对图像生成过弱的经典MMD，与现代编码器结合后变得具有竞争力；三项关键设计发现指导一步生成器的发展。

papers.titleEn: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Interactive Radiology Report Drafting
papers.titleZh: 用于交互式放射科报告起草的离散扩散语言模型
papers.problemEn: Medical foundation models are almost entirely autoregressive, missing the potential of bidirectional discrete diffusion LLMs for interactive, iterative report drafting workflows.
papers.problemZh: 医疗基础模型几乎全部采用自回归架构，错失了双向离散扩散LLM在交互式迭代报告起草流程中的潜力。
papers.innovationEn: DiffusionGemma-26B (a mixture-of-experts discrete diffusion LLM) is adapted to radiology via LoRA and benchmarked against same-size AR Gemma-4-26B, leveraging bidirectional token canvas for interactive drafting.
papers.innovationZh: DiffusionGemma-26B（混合专家离散扩散LLM）通过LoRA适配放射科任务，与同规模自回归Gemma-4-26B对比，利用双向token画布实现交互式起草。
papers.resultEn: Discrete diffusion LLMs match autoregressive quality on medical VQA benchmarks while enabling interactive, iterative report drafting through bidirectional generation.
papers.resultZh: 离散扩散LLM在医疗VQA基准上与自回归模型质量相当，同时通过双向生成实现交互式迭代报告起草。

papers.titleEn: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
papers.titleZh: 通用推理的可迁移性：多领域RLVR的自动化课程
papers.problemEn: Multi-domain RLVR training uses fixed or hand-tuned curricula that ignore whether gradients on a selected domain actually transfer skills to improve performance on other domains.
papers.problemZh: 多领域RLVR训练使用固定或手动调整的课程，忽略了在所选领域的梯度是否真正将技能迁移并提升其他领域性能。
papers.innovationEn: An automated curriculum adapts domain sampling based on cross-domain transferability — selecting domains where training yields gradients that generalize beyond the source domain to improve multi-domain reasoning.
papers.innovationZh: 自动化课程根据跨领域可迁移性自适应调整领域采样——选择训练梯度能够泛化到源领域以外的领域，提升多领域推理能力。
papers.resultEn: Transferability-aware curriculum outperforms fixed and learnability-based curricula for multi-domain reasoning generalization across mathematics, programming, and science.
papers.resultZh: 迁移性感知课程在数学、编程和科学的多领域推理泛化上优于固定课程和基于可学性的课程。

papers.titleEn: Parameter-Efficient Quantum-Inspired Fast Weight Programmers for Traffic-Matrix Forecasting
papers.titleZh: 用于流量矩阵预测的参数高效量子启发快权重程序员
papers.problemEn: Accurate traffic-matrix forecasting under tight memory and training budgets is challenging without dedicated graph, transformer, or diffusion modules for online network control.
papers.problemZh: 在严苛内存和训练预算限制下，针对在线网络控制的精确流量矩阵预测，在没有专用图、Transformer或扩散模块的情况下极具挑战性。
papers.innovationEn: Gated QKAN-FWPs pair a quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold network fast programmer with a classical slow programmer for direct multi-step origin-destination matrix forecasting on the Abilene dataset.
papers.innovationZh: 门控QKAN-FWP将量子启发柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络快程序员与经典慢程序员配对，直接在Abilene数据集上进行多步源-目的矩阵预测。
papers.resultEn: G-QKANFWP achieves the best pooled RMSE using only 22.4% of a larger LSTM's parameters, outperforming matched-size LSTM and classical gated fast-weight programmer baselines.
papers.resultZh: G-QKANFWP以仅占大型LSTM 22.4%的参数量实现最佳汇总RMSE，优于同规模LSTM和经典门控快权重程序员基线。

papers.titleEn: Scaling Laws for Grid-Based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search in High Dimensions
papers.titleZh: 高维近似最近邻搜索的网格方法扩展规律
papers.problemEn: Grid-based ANN search methods have been absent from modern scaling analyses despite potential advantages in high-dimensional or rebuild-heavy settings.
papers.problemZh: 网格型近似最近邻搜索方法尽管在高维或频繁重建场景下潜具优势，却一直缺席现代扩展规律分析。
papers.innovationEn: A systematic characterization of multiprobe grid search over dataset size N and dimensionality d reveals a previously unreported d-scaling crossover: grid search maintains near-constant dimensional scaling while graph-, tree-, and partitioning-based methods degrade.
papers.innovationZh: 对多探针网格搜索关于数据集大小N和维度d的系统性分析，揭示了此前未报告的维度扩展交叉点：网格搜索保持近恒定维度扩展指数，而图、树和划分方法的吞吐量下降。
papers.resultEn: Multiprobe grid search shows near-linear query scaling in N and lower indexing cost than competing ANN methods, making it competitive for high-dimensional and rebuild-heavy applications; self-attention connections suggest implications for efficient transformer cost analysis.
papers.resultZh: 多探针网格搜索展现出关于N的近线性查询扩展和更低的索引成本，在高维和频繁重建应用中具有竞争力；与自注意力的联系暗示对高效Transformer成本分析的启示。
